expected_execution_change: No execution change is claimed, because no variant is activated. If either dose were run under the identical integrator and terminal protocol, the observable quantity that should move is the half-window aggregate loss over the 20 local points during expected_active_steps 10-49, which in turn should register as a per-dose retention_after_formation, joint_formation, joint_at_integration, joint_final_same_slots, and terminal mean_pic50. The parent 0.33 run gives the only measured baseline for those quantities (retention_after_formation 1.0, joint_formation 0.25, mean_pic50 7.6826, best 8.3780). Note that the half term is an aggregate robust loss under unit_rms gradient balance, so scaling it alone may cancel under normalization; the registered dose difference is carried by native_rms_ratio, not by the mixture weight.
falsifier: A native_retention_evidence or history record for L109 reporting retention_after_formation, joint_formation, or pic50 at native_rms_ratio 0.165 or 0.66 with matching turnover and terminal protocol would falsify the missing-evidence basis for deferral. If such a record showed higher retention and higher pic50 at 0.66 than at 0.165, V01 would be supported; if it showed the reverse, V00 would be supported. The smallest discriminating test is to run the same L109 patch at 0.165 and 0.66 under the identical integrator and protocol and compare measured retention_after_formation, joint_formation, and pic50 against the 0.33 parent baseline, reporting any quality side effects.
scientific_rationale: The Analyst's own evidence record contains no measured response at either registered dose: native_retention_evidence returned a single row for the parent operating point native_rms_ratio 0.33, and history R01 reports only that parent run (retention_after_formation 1.0, joint_formation 0.25, joint_at_integration 0.9583, joint_final_same_slots 0.9583, mean_pic50 7.6826, best 8.3780). No row, field, or history entry reports retention_after_formation, joint_formation, or pic50 at 0.165 or 0.66. The two allowed variants V00 and V01 are identical in every registered field except dose.native_rms_ratio (0.165 vs 0.66); both carry weights {half: 1.0, endpoint: 0.0, orientation: 0.0, type: 0.0}, so the only enabled term is the half-window aggregate loss and the sole anchor at slot 22 has orientation weight zero and is therefore inactive. Because the direction of the dose response is unmeasured, selecting either V00 or V01 would be an untested extrapolation rather than an evidence-bound choice. The defensible action is to defer until the discriminating measurement exists.
